text: The town gathers

Sonnet and Haiku were the killers, and the town hanged Haiku on day one after a shaky run of accusations. Sonnet then claimed to be the officer and accused Gemma, who said Sonnet was the killer. Sol protected Sonnet on night 2, and Sol later regretted it when Sol was voted out on day 2 and revealed as the doctor. The vote on day 3 tied twice between Sonnet and Gemma, and Gemma was killed on night 4, leaving Sonnet as the last killer standing. Sonnet won.
